topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: The air around me shifts, bringing scents that don't belong here. Something has been left, a bundle of colors and textures that don't fit in the shadows and light of my world. They stand out, perched on the edge of my resting place. I circle them, unease twisting through my senses. There should be a reason, a scent to match, a presence to explain. But there is nothing, just the alien shapes and the mounting pressure in my chest. I need to know, to understand, but the answers are nowhere, hidden behind the silence of the leaves and the stillness of the forest.
